newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI buys dlrs to stem rupee's rise-dealers.
newsitem.headline: India RBI buys dlrs to stem rupee's rise-dealers.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) bought dollars to stem the rupee's rise minutes before the market closed on Tuesday, dealers said.
Dealers said the RBI intervened after the rupee broke through the 35.70-mark. "They bought at 35.71," a dealer at a leading Bombay bank told Reuters.
"The lowest we did was at 35.6950 today," said a dealer at another bank. The dollar was quoted at 35.715/725 in latest deals after RBI's intervention.
The dollar had opened the day at 35.72/73 rupees.
The market was testing the RBI's resolve for a long time before the central bank reluctantly decided to intervene, dealers said.
